ana: quick check — i'm about to apply a change to staging ExternalSecrets. it's a small annotation + refresh tweak so we can mirror rotated secrets into staging for smoke tests. planning to run `kubectl apply -f` from the infra-runner in ~30m. any blockers?

jamal: can you paste the diff you'll apply? want to confirm it won't touch the vault role binding. :eyes:

ana: sure — here's the manifest i'm going to add/patch for the target namespace `staging-apps`: 
```yaml
apiVersion: external-secrets.io/v1beta1
kind: ExternalSecret
metadata:
  name: app-db-credentials
  namespace: staging-apps
  annotations:
    secret.redwood.io/rotate: "true"
    secret.redwood.io/mirror-to: "staging-mirror"
spec:
  refreshInterval: "1h" # faster refresh for staging smoke runs
  secretStoreRef:
    name: vault-cluster
    kind: ClusterSecretStore
  target:
    name: app-db-credentials
    template:
      type: Opaque
```

tyler: is this managed in terraform/helm? if it's helm values i'd prefer changing values and bumping chart, otherwise apply is okay. we try not to diverge.

ana: good q. For this one the upstream is managed by a helm release but the chart has no per-secret annotations. i checked — small number of staging-only externalsecrets are managed manually right now. i can 1) add to helm values (bigger PR) or 2) patch the single resource for immediate tests. leaning to patch for speed and follow up with helm PR.

mike: what about vault leases and rotation notifications? enabling `secret.redwood.io/rotate: "true"` will trigger mirror behavior, but vault role TTL still applies. if the vault-side role has short TTL we'll see frequent pulls — ok?

ana: vault TTL for that path is 12h currently. mirroring won't increase vault churn because ExternalSecrets only refresh on `refreshInterval` or rotation events. i've set refresh to 1h which should be fine for staging.

jamal: make sure serviceaccount used by externalsecret controller in staging has access to the ClusterSecretStore credential. also check rolebinding scope (we had a bug where namespace-scoped RBAC blocked mirroring).

ana: good call — infra-runner: below is the kubectl patch i'll run (safe, non-destructive):
```bash
kubectl -n staging-apps patch externalsecret app-db-credentials --type='merge' -p '\n{"metadata":{"annotations":{"secret.redwood.io/rotate":"true","secret.redwood.io/mirror-to":"staging-mirror"}},"spec":{"refreshInterval":"1h"}}'
```

infra-bot: PLAN: patch will modify annotations + spec.refreshInterval on ExternalSecret/app-db-credentials in staging-apps (no secrets will be rotated by this command).

tyler: :+1: please hold if you need me to review the helm follow-up.

sre-oncall: i'll be oncall during the apply window, alerting if any vault auth errors spike. ping me just before you run.

ana: thanks — i'll hold for 10m for any last calls, then patch and post the `kubectl get externalsecret -o yaml` after.

mike: FYI we should add a short note in infra-runbook about staging-mirroring so oncall knows to ignore expected refreshes.

ana: noted, adding ticket after patch.

jamal: sounds good. thanks!
